github-mirrors.note: six public one-server mirror repos, name-matching the GitHub repo search axis: mcp-time-tracker, mcp-price-tracker, mcp-spreadsheet, mcp-invoice, mcp-expense-tracker, mcp-office-suite. Each holds only that server's folder at root plus MIRROR.md and a vendored vendor/mcp-license (file: dep) so a fresh clone passes npm install && npm run build && npm test with no monorepo access; office-suite also vendors its five children. Description = tagline from data/facts.json, homepage = https://mcp.zovo.one/s/<name>, topics mcp, mcp-server, model-context-protocol, claude, cursor + 3 server-specific. Regenerate with scripts/sync-mirrors.sh (squashed single commit 'sync from monorepo <sha>', force-push to main). Pro-tier tests are skipped in mirrors: they need keys/license-private.pem, which stays in the monorepo
